summary:
For someone in Saint Vincent And The Grenadines, the three needs areas with the largest gaps are: mobility (0.31), energy (0.55), environment (0.58).
The three strongest areas are: agency (0.81), education (0.75), safety (0.75).
Personal-agent suggestions: focus community-building energy on weakest categories; leverage strongest categories as sources of economic value to bring to the community.
